name: 表示名・説明・保存先・対象と確定をまとめる編集見出し
prompt:
Edit the existing LH09-0245 candidate so the header panel itself fills the entire output canvas. The previous render put the correct panel in the middle of a 3:1 image with large blank white areas above and below. Remove those outside margins by reframing/cropping to the panel's rounded outer boundary while keeping the complete top and bottom edges. The output canvas must be very wide and short, about 1579:173 (9.13:1), roughly 2048x224. Do not return a 3:1 canvas with the panel floating inside it.

Preserve the current panel's internal layout, exact Japanese wording, lock icon and private destination 「個人」, buttons, selected tab, filter controls, icon placement, color and spacing. Keep every part of the top row and bottom tab/filter row visible; do not crop any content. Keep the rounded outer frame at the canvas edges and no extra page background.

Use the primary source crop for the target aspect and frame boundary. Maintain the visible content exactly: title 「優先度の高い作業」, description 「優先度を「高」にした課題」, 「保存先」 plus lock and 「個人」, 「キャンセル」, 「保存」, selected 「課題」, unselected 「案件」, and the right-side filter and sliders icons. Do not change or translate the private save destination to shared.
reviewNotes: v002 preserves source text/control states and correct 個人 lock meaning, but remains 2164x727 (2.977:1) with a large lower blank area and an upper panel taller than the 9.127:1 source crop after a targeted reframe edit. Needs-correction after two attempts.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
